items.disposition: Removed CLEAN direct TSV overlay; integrated CLEAN remains visible, with two explicit rendering regressions. Tutorial historical copy remains outside production scope.

items.finding: Receipt accepts impossible zero-cutoff filtering or missing proteins
items.disposition: Reject filtered_calls !=0 at zero cutoff and require all bound proteins to occur at zero cutoff. Regression added.

items.finding: Invalid cutoff checked after model run
items.disposition: Shared Python cutoff validation now runs before subprocess; Nextflow also rejects invalid cutoff before invoking CLEAN. Regression added.
Added --clean-score-kind; real route harness uses it.

items.finding: Model directory must be writable; abrupt kill cleanup incomplete
items.disposition: Document limitation. UUID isolation avoids reuse; no global cleanup or read-only-model copy abstraction added.

items.finding: Synthetic driver cannot prove native correctness
items.disposition: Agreed. Full541 native attempt separately registered, retained and run via Slurm; no synthetic-model accuracy claim.

items.finding: Receipt does not verify native CSV bytes at import
items.disposition: Documented explicitly: importer validates FASTA and typed output/receipt consistency, not native execution or native CSV hash. Native benchmark retains and checks native bytes separately.

items.finding: Generic conversion can lose native score semantics
items.disposition: Reject typed/CLEAN input in generic converter before output creation; real typed importer required.

items.finding: Two-file publication is not crash atomic
items.disposition: Normal exceptions clean outputs; power-loss/kill may leave incomplete pair, which typed parser rejects. No transactional durability claim.
Claims writers terminate each JSON record with newline; zero-byte builtin stream supported. Controlled dbCAN and CLEAN Nextflow gates check merged raw bytes.
